sources.title: superagent-ai/superagent | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Superagent supports a provider/model format (e.g., openai/gpt-4o, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4) that abstracts multiple AI providers. The system automatically routes requests to the appropriate provider based on the model string.

sources.title: Superagent - Is This The Best AI Agent Tool in 2026?
sources.snippet: Superagent is an open-source runtime protection tool for AI agents and copilots. It inspects prompts, validates tool calls, and blocks threats in real time. The tool functions as a secure proxy between applications, models, and tools. SuperagentLM, its core safety model, analyzes traffic with sub-50ms latency to detect and mitigate risks.
